mainBlocker: Pre-connect test appeared to do nothing; dashboard metrics remained dashes.

facts.claim: The owner's original installed test launched Speed/DIRECT but timed out before producing metrics.
The failure was reproducible independently of the UI.
Root cause was Windows direct-route discovery, not the speed endpoints or base Internet.

decision.selected: Replace slow aggregate NetTCPIP PowerShell route discovery with route.exe IPv4 parsing plus Windows IP Helper interface identity; retain physical-route and broad-override fail-closed guards. Add RUNNING/FAIL/TIMEOUT UI states.
decision.rationale: Removes the measured bottleneck while preserving the existing safety outcome; narrower and faster than increasing the timeout.

rejected.reason: Would mask the slow probe and make the UI wait longer without improving failure visibility.
Could measure a VPN/tunnel path while reporting it as direct.

visualUiPostClick.reason: Remote Commander GUI helper returned GUI_HELPER_TIMEOUT and the minimized WPF instance had no observable UI Automation window handle. Backend success plus the existing Speed success handler predict metric painting, but direct visual observation is missing.

failurePrevention.rootCause: Slow aggregate Windows NetTCPIP route discovery exceeded child deadline.
failurePrevention.prevention: Use bounded route.exe + Windows IP Helper route/interface identity and surface worker RUNNING/FAIL/TIMEOUT states.

publicEvidenceHygiene.rootCause: R45 evidence was assembled with absolute owner-machine paths even though the public-tree security guard already prohibited user-profile paths.
publicEvidenceHygiene.prevention: All public evidence provenance uses symbolic roots (<PROJECT_ROOT>, %LOCALAPPDATA%) rather than owner-specific absolute paths.
publicEvidenceHygiene.regression: security_scan_public.py must PASS before any promotion

exactNextAction: On the already-running owner UI, press the same pre-connect test once and visually confirm Ping/Download/Upload replace dashes. Backend hotfix is already active; no disconnect/restart is required for the successful-result path.

followUpClosure.note: Historical R45 visualUiPostClick remains UNPROVEN for the R45 checkpoint; R46 separately proved the WPF rendered metrics and preserved the active CFON session.
